## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Validation

Describe the checks you ran and any relevant evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and matches the stated scope.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests and validation checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behaviour or operation changed.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private logs, local databases or other sensitive material are included.
- [ ] Security, verification and publication safeguards have not been weakened merely to make checks pass.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out any migration, compatibility, operational or security considerations that deserve particular attention.
